sourceFile.description: The {@link Genai.SourceFile} that the #passage belongs to.

sourceAttribution.description: The result from attribution with corroboration for this source relation.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

from.description: The {@link Genai.Query.Result} that this relation is associated with.

fromStep.description: The {@link Genai.Agent.DynamicTrajectory.Step} that this relation is associated with.

score.description:
The relevance score associated with this {@link Genai.SourceFile} for the {@link Genai.Query.Result#searchQuery}.
Between 0 and 1.

scaledScore.description: Relevance score scaled to 100, for UI display

feedback.description: Feedback on the inclusion of the file into the search results of the query

title:
Link between a {@link Genai.Query.Result} and one of the {@link Genai.SourcePassage}s that was deemed 'relevant' to
the user's query. These results are used to populate the relevant documents section of the UI, but except for the
first few, are not used for generating the answer.
name: Genai.Query.ResultToPassageRelation
